items.name: Durga Kund Temple
items.summary: A red-coloured Durga temple beside the Durga Kund tank in southern Varanasi.

items.name: Annapurna Devi Temple
items.summary: A shrine to Annapurna, the goddess of nourishment, near Kashi Vishwanath.

items.name: Kaal Bhairav Temple, Varanasi
items.summary: Bhairava is revered here as the guardian of Kashi in the city's living pilgrimage tradition.

items.name: Krishna Janmasthan Temple Complex
items.summary: Mathura's temple complex commemorates Krishna's birthplace in Hindu tradition.

items.name: Banke Bihari Temple
items.summary: A major Braj shrine where Banke Bihari is worshipped through distinctive darshan and seva traditions.

items.name: Prem Mandir
items.summary: A marble temple complex whose reliefs and garden displays narrate episodes from Krishna and Rama traditions.

items.name: Radha Raman Temple
items.summary: A Gaudiya Vaishnava shrine associated with Gopala Bhatta Goswami and the Radha Raman deity.

items.name: ISKCON Krishna Balaram Mandir
items.summary: An ISKCON pilgrimage centre in Raman Reti devoted to Krishna and Balarama.

items.name: Vindhyavasini Temple
items.summary: A major goddess shrine in Vindhyachal, linked with the area's three-temple pilgrimage tradition.

items.name: Gorakhnath Temple
items.summary: A Nath monastic and temple centre associated with the yogi Gorakhnath.

items.name: Brahma Temple, Pushkar
items.summary: A prominent Brahma shrine near Pushkar Lake, central to the town's pilgrimage landscape.

items.name: Karni Mata Temple
items.summary: A temple to Karni Mata distinguished by its protected resident rats and the reverence shown to them.

items.name: Khatu Shyam Temple
items.summary: Devotion centres on Shyam, identified with Barbarika in a Mahabharata-linked tradition and associated with Krishna's blessing.

items.name: Salasar Balaji Temple
items.summary: A Hanuman pilgrimage centre in Salasar where Balaji is represented with a beard and moustache.

items.name: Mehandipur Balaji Temple
items.summary: A Hanuman shrine with distinctive local ritual traditions; observe the temple's current visitor guidance respectfully.

items.name: Shrinathji Temple
items.summary: A Pushtimarg haveli temple with darshan organised around the daily seva of Shrinathji.

items.name: Govind Dev Ji Temple
items.summary: A Radha-Krishna shrine within Jaipur's royal precinct, closely tied to the city's devotional life.

items.name: Eklingji Temple
items.summary: A Mewar temple complex dedicated to Eklingji, a form of Shiva associated with the region's rulers.

items.name: Jwala Ji Temple
items.summary: The goddess is worshipped through natural flames rather than a conventional central idol.

items.name: Chintpurni Temple
items.summary: A major hill-region goddess pilgrimage in the Una area.

items.name: Naina Devi Temple, Bilaspur
items.summary: A hilltop goddess shrine above the plains near the Punjab-Himachal border.

items.name: Chamunda Devi Temple
items.summary: A goddess temple near the Baner river in the Kangra region.

items.name: Bajreshwari Devi Temple
items.summary: A historic goddess shrine in Kangra associated with the region's Shakti pilgrimage tradition.

items.name: Baijnath Temple
items.summary: A stone Shiva temple noted for its medieval Nagara architecture and inscriptions.
